title: payment.disputed.v1
description: A dispute was opened, advanced or resolved against a payment. Published by Ledger & Reconciliation (BC-8) on pp.payments.payment.v1, keyed by payment_id, because disputes arrive from gateway webhooks and settlement reports rather than being decided by the orchestrator. A dispute is NOT a refund and deliberately does not share its shape: a refund is a merchant decision, a dispute is imposed on the merchant, and conflating them makes chargeback ratios unmeasurable.

reasonCode.description: Normalized reason. Scheme reason codes differ per network and per gateway; mapping them here is the anti-corruption layer's job so that risk models are not written against a single scheme's vocabulary.

stage.description: How far the dispute has escalated. Each stage has different evidence deadlines and different cost.

outcome.description: Absent while the dispute is open. LOST reverses funds and moves the payment to REFUNDED; WON restores them.

evidenceDueBy.description: The deadline for submitting evidence. Missing it loses the dispute by default, so this drives merchant notification urgency.
